title: 4 AM Silent Pitch: One Ball, One Healing Arc
caption:
4 AM. One ball, one empty pitch, one last shot.
A worn ball waits alone on a floodlit pitch through the night; at dawn it arcs into the net in golden light.
Loop it late at night and watch the darkness slowly turn to morning.
When was the last time you trained just for yourself?
Save this for the days you need a quiet push.
